main.description: Delete one recovery bundle (decision J2: removing a recovery method) and its ORF state, releasing the mailbox counters. The caller has already rotated the bundle's device out of the epoch and marked it revoked; its device record and past epoch memberships stay. Mailbox endpoint. Requires a bound Labyrinth device (a current, non-virtual device registered by the calling chat device). Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
